correctness.rationale: Read the frozen fan-graph RESULT.md, its majority rule with tie retention, and verification program. For a constant hub the endpoint-reflexive AND/OR path map has only monochromatic recurrent states; a flipping hub gives x=DEx and strict inequalities 2|x|>n>2|Ex|. The neighborhoods form an auxiliary n-cycle; DE x=x means no isolated cyclic 1s, with e=k-r internal 11 edges and r runs. Cyclic composition counting yields n/r*binom(k-r-1,r-1)*binom(n-k-1,r-1) and excludes n=4. Independently enumerated the actual majority update for n=3..11 and matched fixed states, primitive cycles and run formula, including count sequence 3,0,5,3,21,16,66,65,220. The weighted four-state transfer has characteristic z*(z^3-(1+uv)z^2+uv*z-u^2*v); Perron eigenvalue lambda solves lambda^3-2lambda^2+lambda-1=0. Its weighted mean inequalities mu_k>1/2>mu_e yield exponentially small inadmissible words by tilting and hence C_n=lambda^n+O(eta^n) with eta<lambda. The proof is all n>=3; finite enumeration is corroboration.
